metadata.title: The Stolen Family Recipe
metadata.subtitle: A mega-franchise opened across the street serving Grandma's 40-year secret broth—right after my cousin bought a Porsche.

nodes.text: 11:40 AM · Grand Opening across the street. Lines stretch down the block for Rex’s new "Heritage Noodle House."
Marco, I just tasted Rex’s broth. Smoked black cardamom, charred shallot, star anise—that is word-for-word Grandma’s notebook!
Relax, Morgan. Everyone makes noodle soup. Maybe they just have better chefs than you.
Rex, wire the final $100K—I already photographed all 12 pages of Grandma’s red notebook!
Hi Morgan! Love your little shop. Give us 30 days and I’ll buy your building for pennies on the dollar.

nodes.transcript: [chuckling softly] Don't cry, Morgan. The red notebook on the kitchen shelf is my decoy book. Remember the secret ingredient I only ever taught YOU by hand?

nodes.prompt: Food critics are filming Rex’s grand opening right now. Your counter-attack?

options.label: Offer free blind-taste bowls to the press
options.player_reply_text: Grandma, fire up the real pot! Let the food critics taste the difference live.

options.label: Reveal the decoy bitter-herb mistake
options.player_reply_text: Wait—Grandma, didn’t your decoy notebook double the licorice root so it turns bitter after 3 hours?!

nodes.text: Broth is simmering. Bring the cameras over—40 years of soul cannot be photocopied.
DECOY ACTIVATED: Right at 2 PM, Rex’s giant 200-liter franchise vat turns intensely bitter—right as the top food critic takes a live bite on camera!
MARCO! Why is the critic spitting out our broth on livestream?! What did you sell me?!
Morgan, stop the cameras! Rex is threatening to sue me for $250,000!

nodes.headline: Bitter Taste of Betrayal
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 2: The livestream crew crosses the street into YOUR restaurant—while Rex storms in demanding Marco’s head.

nodes.text: 02:15 PM · Your family restaurant. Fifty customers and three livestream cameras pack the tables.
Marco! You swore that red notebook was the authentic 40-year recipe! I paid you $250,000!
Oops—did you just confess on a 40,000-viewer livestream that you paid my cousin to steal trade secrets, Mr. Rex?
PR team shut down our social media right now!! We’re trending #1 for theft!!

nodes.transcript: [smiling warmly] Marco, you never once woke up at 4 AM to skim the bones with me. That’s why you never learned the real recipe.

nodes.prompt: Marco begs you to forgive him in front of Grandma. What do you say?

options.label: Revoke his family share & let Rex sue him
options.player_reply_text: Sell the Porsche to pay Rex back, Marco. You’re no longer welcome in this kitchen.

options.label: Offer to buy Rex’s lease for pennies
options.player_reply_text: By the way, Mr. Rex—give it 30 days and I’ll buy your storefront across the street for pennies.

nodes.text: The food critic gives your bowl a 10/10 on air. Reservations sell out for the next six months.
VIRAL VICTORY: Rex’s franchise shuts down in two weeks—and your family expands into his prime corner flagship!
Look at that line out the door, Morgan. Our legacy is safe in your hands.
Four AM tomorrow, Grandma. Let’s make double the broth.

nodes.headline: Legacy Served Hot
nodes.teaser_text: That evening, an international Michelin inspector slips a plain white card onto your counter.

nodes.text: 9:15 AM · Grandma’s Noodle Shop. The Michelin inspector’s white card gleams on the wooden counter.
Morgan, I still can’t believe it! That quiet gentleman finished every single drop of our 14-hour bone broth!
Wait—check the local food blog! Rex just paid influencers to post fake food-poisoning reviews about our shop!

nodes.caption: NON-COMPETE TRAP · Rex tricked Marco into signing away the family shop’s trademarked name for $15K.

nodes.text: Morgan, I messed up SO bad! Rex isn’t just smearing you—he’s using the contract I signed to send a cease-and-desist to shut Grandma’s shop down!
Once Grandma’s original shop closes, nobody will know our broth is powdered—

nodes.transcript: [ladle clinking calmly] Don’t panic, Morgan. Marco never owned the shop name—I trademarked it in 1986 under MY name, and I never gave Marco the final midnight herb step!

nodes.prompt: Rex’s lawyers and a health inspector just walked through your front door! Your move?

options.label: Welcome the inspector to tour the kitchen
options.player_reply_text: Come right into our kitchen, Inspector—stainless steel, fresh bones simmering 14 hours, zero powders!

options.label: Livestream the spotless inspection + 1986 deed
options.player_reply_text: Going LIVE right now—showing our 100/100 kitchen AND Grandma’s 1986 trademark certificate!

nodes.text: A+ SCORE: The inspector awards a spotless 100/100 hygiene score and notes the complaint was clearly malicious!
500K VIEWS: Food lovers flood the comments exposing Rex’s smear campaign; a line forms around your block!
Enjoy the little viral stunt while it lasts! My franchise has 40 locations—we’ll bury your tiny corner shop!
Wait… Rex’s flagship across the street is empty! Customers are spitting out his broth because he replaced real marrow with cheap extract!

nodes.headline: The Missing Midnight Spice
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 4: Rex’s copycat broth implodes—and Marco reveals the shady supplier kickback behind it.

nodes.text: 2:10 PM · Across the Street. Rex’s mega-franchise dining room sits half-empty while your line stretches down the block.
Marco! You swore you gave me the complete recipe! Why are food critics calling my broth "salty dishwater"?!
Because you fired the butcher and switched to expired concentrate from your cousin’s warehouse to save 30%!
EXPIRED concentrate?! Marco, do you have proof Rex is serving expired ingredients across 40 restaurants?!
Shut up Marco—if the health board sees my supplier kickback invoices—
Stealing my recipe was greedy, Rex—but feeding bad food to families is unforgivable!

nodes.transcript: [keys jingling] Morgan, I’m returning the leased Porsche to the dealer today—and I’m bringing you the supplier invoices Rex made me hide in the back office!

nodes.prompt: Marco is walking across the street with Rex’s secret supplier invoices! What do you do?

options.label: Hand the expired-goods proof to inspectors
options.player_reply_text: Send those invoices straight to the City Health Department—protect every diner in this city!

options.label: Report to Health Dept + sue for trademark
options.player_reply_text: Call the Health Department AND file a trademark infringement suit using Grandma’s 1986 registration!

nodes.text: SURPRISE RAID: Health inspectors cross the street twenty minutes later and find 60 expired drums in Rex’s freezer!
TOTAL SHUTDOWN: Inspectors slap a red closure notice on Rex’s door while his corporate franchise partners pull out!
You can copy a sign, Rex, but you can’t fake forty years of honest cooking.
Wait—the inspectors just chained my kitchen doors! Who leaked my supplier ledger?!

nodes.headline: The Kickback Trail Exposed
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 5: Expose the supplier kickback wire and await the official Michelin announcement.

nodes.text: 5:30 PM · Grandma’s Dining Room. The evening news airs a special report on the franchise raid.
Look what the investigators just released—Rex was pocketing $80,000 a month in kickbacks from that expired-goods warehouse!

nodes.caption: KICKBACK RECEIPT · $80,000/mo from Discount Food Depot → Rex’s Personal LLC (Expired Broth Stock).

nodes.text: My board just ousted me and the landlord evicted the branch across from you… happy now?!
We’re too busy simmering tonight’s fresh broth to think about you, Rex.
I don’t deserve to ever step back into Grandma’s kitchen again—

nodes.transcript: [email notification chime] Morgan! Come read my tablet—an official invitation from the Michelin Guide Gala just arrived! Our little shop is on the list!

nodes.prompt: Marco stands nervously by the back door holding a dishwashing apron. What do you say?

options.label: Hand him a scrub brush—earn back trust
options.player_reply_text: Tie that apron on, Marco. You betrayed us, then you helped save diners—start at the sink and earn Grandma’s trust back.

options.label: Let Marco earn trust + lease Rex’s old space
options.player_reply_text: Start at the sink, Marco—because next month we’re leasing Rex’s vacated space across the street as Grandma’s Flagship!

nodes.text: HUMBLE RETURN: Marco’s eyes well up as he rolls up his sleeves and scrubs every pot until it shines.
ULTIMATE FLEX: Grandma bursts into laughter—"Forty years in a tiny corner, and now we own both sides of the street!"
Tomorrow night we put on our best clothes for the Michelin Gala, Morgan!
I’ll guard the midnight broth pot while you two walk the red carpet. Promise.

nodes.headline: Michelin Night Arrives
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 6 (Finale): Step onto the culinary red carpet with Grandma and claim the honor she earned over 40 years.

nodes.text: 8:30 PM · Michelin Guide Gala Ballroom. Spotlights swing toward Grandma’s table as the announcer reads your shop’s name.
WE WON!! A Michelin Bib Gourmand plaque for our little 40-year broth shop!!
Forty years of waking up at 4 AM to simmer real bones—nobody on earth deserves this more than you, Grandma!
Watching the livestream from the kitchen! The broth pot is simmering right at 88°C—and the morning queue is ALREADY forming outside!
A Michelin plaque—and I threw away my whole company trying to copy them—

nodes.transcript: [crowd cheering] Morgan, I’m handing you the brass keys to the flagship kitchen tonight. You protected our soul—now carry it for the next forty years!

nodes.text: I’ll guard the midnight herb step with my life, Grandma—and never cut a single corner.

nodes.prompt: Your first celebratory gesture back at the shop tomorrow morning:

options.label: Serve 100 free bowls to neighborhood seniors
options.player_reply_text: Tomorrow morning, the first 100 bowls are FREE for our neighborhood elders who supported Grandma since 1986!

options.label: Free bowls + open Grandma’s Broth Academy
options.player_reply_text: 100 free bowls tomorrow—AND we’re launching a free culinary apprenticeship in Grandma’s name for young chefs!

nodes.text: COMMUNITY LOVE: Local TV covers the heartwarming celebration—turning your shop into a beloved city landmark.
CULINARY IMMORTALITY: Michelin editors feature your story worldwide—proof that honesty always tastes best.
Come home soon—I saved two steaming bowls for our champions!
Legacy served hot, Morgan. Always.

nodes.headline: FINALE · Forty Years Of Honor
nodes.teaser_text: You defeated the copycat franchise, exposed the food fraud, and won Michelin glory with Grandma.
